description: Al-Khair Gadoon Limited was incorporated as a private limited company on 27 August 1990 and converted into a public limited company on 31 August 1995. It is principally engaged in the manufacturing and sale of foam and allied products, and describes itself as an ISO 9001:2015 certified producer of high-quality polyurethane foam developed through industrial partnerships with Shell (Singapore) and BASF (Korea).
headOffice: Alkhair House, 43-T, Gurumangat Road, Block T, Gulberg 2, Lahore 54660, Pakistan
sourceNote: Written from: https://dps.psx.com.pk/company/AKGL (incorporation and conversion dates, principal activity), https://alkhairfoam.com/pages/company-profile (ISO 9001:2015, polyurethane foam, Shell and BASF partnerships), https://alkhairfoam.com/pages/contact (Alkhair House address and telephone) and the product menu on https://alkhairfoam.com (mattress and foam range) (accessed 2026-10-17). No chief executive is named on the pages read, so ceo is null.
